## ESP32 Wireless Defense Lab v1.0.0

First maintained defensive release.

### Included

- Passive deauthentication/disassociation observation.
- Per-source threshold alerts.
- Nearby Wi-Fi inventory with SSID/BSSID/channel/RSSI/security.
- Channel occupancy view.
- Protected local dashboard.
- Mandatory first-boot credential replacement.
- HTTP Digest authentication and CSRF protection.
- AES-GCM protected local credentials with per-device master secret.
- Serial-assisted credential recovery.
- Optional OLED status display.
- Browser installer, CI builds and SHA-256 release checksums.

### Defensive scope

This maintained release is receive-only. It does not include deauthentication transmission, Evil Twin impersonation, credential collection, WPA/PMKID capture, beacon flooding, BLE flooding or HID injection.

### Validation

CI verifies host frame-classification logic and ESP32 compilation. Physical-board detection sensitivity, false-positive rate, RF coverage and long-duration stability still require hardware testing.
